title: Chapter 5: Beauty’s Sacrifice and Departure
chineseTitle: 第 5 章：贝儿的牺牲与离别时刻

paragraphs.en: The heart-broken merchant arrived home in tears and presented the fateful rose to Beauty, telling his weeping children of the terrifying bargain he had made with the Beast. Upon hearing the tale, the two eldest sisters turned upon Beauty with vicious hatred: 'Look at what your foolish rose has cost our father!' they shrieked. 'You ought to die for your silly vanity, but you will let our father perish while you stay safe at home!'
paragraphs.zh: 心碎的商人含泪回到家，将那朵决定命运的玫瑰递给贝儿，向哭泣的孩子们讲述了他与野兽作出的可怕交易。一听到这个故事，两个大姐姐带着恶毒的仇恨冲着贝儿咆哮：“看看你愚蠢的玫瑰给我们父亲带来了什么代价！”她们尖叫道。“你本该为了你傻乎乎的虚荣去死，但你却要让我们父亲丧命，而你安全地待在家里！”

paragraphs.en: Beauty remained perfectly calm, wiping her tear-stained face with dignity. 'No,' she said resolutely. 'My father shall not suffer for my sake. Since the Beast will accept a daughter, I shall gladly go in his place, and no power on earth will alter my decision.' Despite her father's desperate weeping and her brothers' offers to fight the Beast, Beauty stood firm, preparing for her journey.
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿保持着绝对的平静，带着尊严擦干沾满泪水的脸庞。“不，”她坚定地说。“我的父亲不能为了我受苦。既然野兽会接受一个女儿，我将欣然代替他前去，世上没有任何力量能改变我的决定。”尽管她父亲绝望地哭泣，哥哥们提出去与野兽决斗，贝儿依然立场坚定，为旅程做准备。

paragraphs.en: When the three months expired, Beauty and her father rode back to the enchanted palace. The grand hall was lit with candles, and a sumptuous feast for two was prepared. As they dined in heavy silence, the heavy footfalls of the Beast echoed through the corridor. The hideous creature entered, his terrible form making Beauty shudder, though she forced herself to stand tall.
paragraphs.zh: 当三个月到期时，贝儿和她的父亲骑马回到了魔法城堡。大厅里点亮了蜡烛，为两个人准备了丰盛的盛宴。当他们在沉重的寂静中用餐时，野兽沉重的脚步声在走廊里回荡。这个丑陋的生物进来了，他可怕的外形让贝儿瑟瑟发抖，尽管她强迫自己挺直身姿。
